name: ¿KS v Ozerkah?
source:
Alisa has unconsciously burned herself out from an overdose of people. It feels like nothing can surprise her anymore. Denis is terrified of trying to find his place under the sun in the wonderful world of food service. What if people notice him? Danya got kicked out of the aquarium. And all he did was touch every single fish there. Totally unfair.

Forget it, guys. The grim side of Saint Petersburg will sort everything out and neatly stack it on the shelves of the fridge. Everything that ends up in Ozerki leaves its liver behind there.
translation:
艾丽莎不知不觉地因服药过量而精疲力尽。感觉已经没有什么能让她惊讶了。丹尼斯害怕试图在美妙的餐饮服务世界中找到自己的位置。如果人们注意到他怎么办？丹尼娅被赶出了水族馆。他所做的就是触摸那里的每一条鱼。完全不公平。

忘了它吧，伙计们。圣彼得堡阴暗的一面会把所有东西整理好，整齐地堆放在冰箱的架子上。所有进入奥泽基的东西都会留下它的肝脏。
